IBM is a technology and consulting company focused on cloud, artificial intelligence, and enterprise technology solutions. The Software Developer will design, implement, integrate, deploy, and support distributed software and database capabilities for GenAI applications, including Astra/Apache Cassandra, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, and Hybrid Search.

Responsibilities
Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and customer-reported issues to diagnose root causes of complex application or network concerns
Design solutions, including drafting architecture diagrams and technical specifications of new components of Astra/Apache Cassandra-related software, that enhance efficiency, reliability, and scalability
Integrate advanced features to support enterprise GenAI applications
Implement solutions in computer languages, applying advanced concepts in distributed computing and software engineering
Perform systems management and integration functions, ensuring compatibility across modules and APIs
Deploy and manage solutions in multi-cloud environments to ensure seamless scalability and reliability
Optimize performance by refining algorithms and enhancing concurrency to handle large-scale workloads
Create new database features that meet scalability, availability, and multi-tenancy requirements
Enhance existing functionality to improve system performance and end-user experience
Engineer core infrastructure for GenAI, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for augmented retrieval and Hybrid Search combining lexical and vector searches
Diagnose and resolve defects through rigorous debugging, testing, and code review
Coordinate software release processes, integrating deliverables from multiple engineering teams
Collaborate with GenAI-related teams to integrate GenAI features for AI-powered agents and workflows
Provide ongoing support for customers, including troubleshooting escalations and delivering fixes
Review and contribute to technical documentation to ensure accuracy and clarity for users
Utilize: Java, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Hybrid Search, Reactive Programming, Apache Cassandra, Kubernetes (K8s), gRPC (gRPC Remote Procedure Calls)

One (1) year of experience must include utilizing Java, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Hybrid Search, Reactive Programming, Apache Cassandra, Kubernetes (K8s), gRPC (gRPC Remote Procedure Calls)
